verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents human-approval gating in two contexts — AI agent actions that 'wait for your approval' before executing (docs-31, docs-42) and a publish-approval flow for Sensitive projects (docs-43) — but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'pause and wait for human input/approval' step usable mid-execution within an ordinary automation flow. missing for 10: a documented flow-level 'wait for approval' or 'human input' action/piece, evidence of how a paused run resumes after approval is given, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this capability.
